# Tinlance System Integration & Conformance

> TSIC is the canonical integration control plane for defining, validating, and certifying interoperability across the Tinlance system-of-systems.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): Product positioning, quick start, repository map, and usage.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): Navigation across tutorials, how-to guides, explanation, and reference.
- [Governance](GOVERNANCE.md): Ownership boundaries and authority rules.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting and security controls.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution, compatibility, and verification requirements.

## Architecture

- [Canonical system model](docs/architecture/canonical-system-model.md): Authoritative system and path model.
- [Authority model](docs/architecture/authority-model.md): Capability ownership and boundaries.
- [Integration topology](docs/architecture/integration-topology.md): System-to-system relationships.
- [Identity and agent registration](docs/architecture/identity-and-agent-registration.md): Identity propagation and registration contracts.
- [Model and agent interoperability](docs/architecture/model-and-agent-interoperability.md): Routing and interoperability controls.

## Contracts and verification

- [Event and trace fabric](docs/contracts/event-and-trace-fabric.md): Event envelope, delivery, and trace concepts.
- [Adapter fabric](docs/integrations/adapter-fabric.md): Cross-system adapter rules.
- [End-to-end integration](docs/operations/e2e-integration.md): Canonical executable workflows.
- [Failure and recovery certification](docs/operations/failure-recovery-certification.md): Recovery scenarios and certification.
- [Production system-of-systems certification](docs/certification/production-system-of-systems.md): Repository-level certification boundary.

## Machine-readable surfaces

- [Ecosystem manifest](manifests/ecosystem.json): Registered systems and authorities.
- [Capability authority catalog](catalog/capabilities/authority.json): Capability ownership.
- [Contract registry](catalog/contracts/registry.json): Versioned normative contracts.
- [Service registry](catalog/services/registry.json): Registered services and protocols.
- [Dependency graph](catalog/dependencies/graph.json): Canonical dependencies.
- [Canonical workflows](workflows/canonical.json): Integration paths.
- [Ecosystem lock](policies/ecosystem-lock.json): Enforcement policy.
